question_text: Four charges each of $\pm q$ are fixed at the vertices of a square ABCD as shown in the figure. If the two charges at A and B are vanished simultaneously, which of the following is not true regarding the movement of the particle of charge $-q$ at O? (Neglect the gravitational effects and the air resistance on the particle).

options.option_text: It will begin to accelerate in the direction OP.
It will arrive at P from O with maximum acceleration.
Once it passes maximum acceleration at P.
Along OP it will return to O. It will move further distance of magnitude OP.
